stem.text: Which statements about tRNA structure are correct?

items: There is a binding site for the attachment of a specific amino acid and a different binding site for the attachment to the ribosome, so that translation can occur.
There is a ribose-phosphate backbone with strong phosphodiester bonds and areas within the polynucleotide chain where base pairing occurs.
There is an anticodon that contains the same triplet of bases as the triplet of DNA bases that has been transcribed to produce the mRNA codon.
